info.title: On-chain Forensics API
info.description: Pay-per-call on-chain forensics: Canton Network (CC) burn/mint tracking, Linea burn-vault audit, ERC-20 burn/mint forensics for any token on Base or Ethereum mainnet (named aliases: ondo, qnt, edel, xlm, aero, degen, brett, buidl, usdy, ousg, ustb, usyc, bcspx, bcoin, bnvda, btsla, aapl, nvda (incl. tokenized treasuries BUIDL/USDY/OUSG/USTB/USYC and tokenized equities bTSLA/bNVDA/bCOIN/bCSPX, AAPL, NVDA)), wallet flow analysis for any address on Base or Ethereum mainnet, plus a token verdict card (activity metrics, verdict tier, shareable take) for any ERC-20. Payments via the x402 protocol: unpaid requests receive HTTP 402 with machine-readable payment requirements in the PAYMENT-REQUIRED header (USDC on Base).

get.description: Returns the requested forensics dataset. Requires x402 v2 USDC payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header; 402 challenge in PAYMENT-REQUIRED header).

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Named token alias (endpoint=token); resolves chain+contract automatically

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Chain to read (endpoint=token with a raw contract; endpoint=wallet for wallet analysis)

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Wallet address (endpoint=wallet), ERC-20 token contract (endpoint=verdict), or token contract to screen (endpoint=settlesafe)

parameters.name: counterparty
parameters.description: Optional counterparty wallet to trust-screen (endpoint=settlesafe): returns trust_tier TRUSTED_ACTIVITY/LIGHT_ACTIVITY/NO_RECENT_ACTIVITY/SUSPICIOUS/EMPTY/CONTRACT_ADDRESS

200.description: Paid response: JSON forensics dataset (payment settled via x402)

402.description: Payment Required: PAYMENT-REQUIRED header carries base64 x402 v2 PaymentRequired (USDC on Base, CAIP-2 eip155:8453, scheme exact); pay via PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header
